responsibility: Declares the helper that compiles a single HIR struct-expression field into the corresponding value tree. The interface distinguishes identifier shorthand, identifier-with-value, and index-based fields and exists specifically to support struct literal lowering from the main expression compiler.
same_name_distinction: Declares the helper class for compiling a single struct-expression field and its per-field-kind visit methods. Unlike rust-compile-struct-field-expr.cc, it provides only the interface used by the main expression compiler, not the shorthand-to-path translation or value-lowering code.
